narrative: A 77-year-old, has histologically confirmed adenocarcinoma of the lung, staged as IIIB (T3N2M0). The disease has progressed following prior systemic therapy. Imaging shows measurable disease per RECIST v1.1. A malignant pleural effusion is present. He has an ECOG performance status of 0. Molecular profiling showed no actionable driver mutation. Cardiac history includes a myocardial infarction more than 6 months ago. He previously received immunotherapy (over 6 months ago). Pulmonary function testing showed an FEV1 of 43% predicted.

Cardiac history includes a myocardial infarction more than 6 months ago.

Laboratory values: creatinine 1.8 mg/dL, ANC 2.1 x10^3, platelets 323k, hemoglobin 9.4 g/dL, bilirubin 1.5 mg/dL. He previously received chemotherapy, TKI therapy (3-6 months ago).
